def shade(cell, color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"),"clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"),"auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"),color)

def para(text, bold_lead=None, style=None, size=None, italic=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    if bold_lead:
        r = p.add_run(bold_lead); r.bold = True
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    r = p.add_run(text); r.italic = italic
    if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    return p

def bullet(text, lead=None, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level==0 else "List Bullet 2")
    if lead:
        r = p.add_run(lead); r.bold = True
    p.add_run(text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def table(headers, rows, widths=None, fs=9):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""
        r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(fs); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)
        shade(c, "1F3A5F")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i,v in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            p = cells[i].paragraphs[0]
            if isinstance(v, tuple):
                r = p.add_run(v[0]); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(fs)
            else:
                r = p.add_run(str(v)); r.font.size = Pt(fs)
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i,w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t
